summary: V5.1.2 iter22 backend + partial frontend validation. All 13 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter22_v512.py PASS on the preview host: change-password rejects wrong current (403) and succeeds with correct (200) and is reverted to the original PieGod08!! credential; PATCH /api/auth/me round-trips byline_name/avatar_url/bio; POST /api/uploads/avatar accepts a 1x1 PNG (200) and rejects text/plain (400) and >4MB payload (413); GET /api/systems/cypher/reference ships pool_baseline=7 + tier_derived.{recoveries_per_day,recovery_die} + each TYPES entry carries pool_offsets/starting_edge/starting_cypher_limit; POST /api/sessions/{sid}/seat-character seats and releases the owner's Cypher character; POST /api/sessions/{sid}/assign-character GM-overrides for Fran and 403s a freshly-registered non-member player; GET /api/campaigns/{cid}/export.pdf?mode=narrative bypasses the Cypher forbidden-setting 451 gate on campaign 22ee28aa and returns the documented 400 'No sessions to export.' empty state (no sessions exist on that campaign) — NOT a bug per the request note. Frontend Playwright sweep confirms /app/account renders all sections with the correct testids (account-page, account-identity, account-avatar, account-avatar-input, account-avatar-upload-btn, account-stats + five stat cells, account-profile-patch, account-byline-input, account-bio-input, account-profile-save, account-password-card, account-pw-current/new/confirm, account-pw-save, nav-account, bottom-nav-account). End-to-end avatar upload via the UI succeeded — the returned URL (/api/uploads/avatars/.png) was persisted and the refreshed on-page. Characters tab on the Cypher campaign renders card-system-{charId} = card-system-a129db2a8eb44e3b849de6fff876e9f5 as required (system-aware preview, no BESM leak).

issues: The identity grid places the EMAIL value column immediately adjacent to the ROLE label and the two strings visually collide ('franpietrowski@gmail.comROLE' renders with no gap on a 1920-wide viewport). Likely a column-gap / grid-template-columns bump needed in Account.jsx's identity section.

action_items: Cosmetic only — widen the gap (or switch to a 2-col gap-6 grid) in Account.jsx's account-identity card so EMAIL and ROLE values don't visually touch on desktop.

Character-sheet derived block (Armor / Cypher Limit / Recoveries / Effort) could not be reached via /app/campaigns/{cid}/characters/{char_id} in this sweep — URL pattern may differ; routing testid map did not include a sheet-level testid in the visited view. Confirm the canonical route for CharacterSheet.jsx + CypherSheetView so the next agent can assert sheet-armor / sheet-cypher-limit / sheet-recoveries / sheet-effort testids without guessing.
critical_code_review_comments: avatar upload endpoint correctly persists avatar_url on the user record (uploads.py line 147) and the sibling-extension cleanup loop (lines 138-143) prevents stale PNG/JPEG/WEBP files from stacking up — good.
change-password endpoint uses the stored hash (not the possibly-stale cached user) when re-verifying (auth.py line 109 re-reads from db.users). Correct — prevents a classic stale-session bypass.
seat-character validates ownership before seating (sessions.py lines 106-112) and GM/admin override is gated on camp['gm_id'] == user['id'] or role=='admin' (line 145). Clean.
Narrative PDF gate: mode='narrative' short-circuits the _setting_violates_licence check (pdf_export.py line 1308) and substitutes _narrative_profile. Verified behaviour matches the spec.
Minor design: Account.jsx identity card uses a 4-col layout that causes the EMAIL value to run into the ROLE label. Non-blocking but worth a column-gap bump.

success_rate.frontend: Verified: account page renders all sections + avatar upload end-to-end + Characters tab card-system-{id} testid present. NOT exercised this run: character-sheet derived block (route unclear) and SessionView take-seat-section (no existing session on the target campaign; creation + navigation not driven through the UI this iteration, though the underlying seat-character/assign-character APIs are green via pytest).
